glosses: diverse (composed of people with a variety of different demographic characteristics)

examples.en: There are various kinds of coffee.

examples.text: Eu já vi isto acontecer diversas vezes.
examples.en: I've seen it happen too many times already.

examples.text: Tom é parecido comigo de diversas formas.
examples.en: Tom is similar to me in many ways.
Several students came to the library.

examples.text: Nós falamos acerca de diversos assuntos.
examples.en: We talked about a lot of stuff.
